about: SCION 43 rewrite rulebook. Time base: score frames, 24 fps; the dog graph is solved on twos. Coordinates: metres along the porch (x), height (v); screen X = 278 + 195 x.

rules.precondition: intention changes (score act.head / state); the new drawing's native neck->nose angle within 45 deg of the wanted angle
rules.motif: head up = attention; head low = the decision to come (f048: the dog lowering its head to its bowl, re-used as trust)

rules.id: R2 REPLACE head by the looking-away head
rules.precondition: state becomes watch (7.458, on its own frame) while the body still faces away; legibility: muzzle left of the neck, level (<= 20 deg), head at normal scale, clear of the back, with its own paper rim; the body stays lying (no hybrid) until the found turn frames at 7.75
fragments: head_alert_f006 rotated level about its neck (muzzle to the door, 8 deg)
rules.motif: the head comes round first: turning to look

rules.id: R3 MERGE dog -> whole found frame
rules.precondition: a turn: |facing| changes sign; the found frame must show the same dog between profiles
rules.preserved: ground point under the body, height 0.80 m (local)
rules.motif: the turn is never a mirror flip: the real dog turning, two found frames

rules.output: dog graph facing the other way

rules.precondition: gait phase: stance -> straight found leg, swing -> bent found leg
rules.preserved: hip/shoulder anchor; a stance foot keeps its world x (visual anchor)

rules.output: lying graph (discrete drawings; hind legs EXIT from 2/3 down; lying at the sill starts half down on its own frame)
rules.precondition: score act.lie quantised (thirds; quarters from 1/2 for lie_down)
rules.motif: lying is composed: no frame of this dog lies down

rules.input: dog node cut from the shaded frames (f006/f012)
rules.output: same node cut from the sunlit frames (f045/f048), blended in by weight
rules.precondition: state in {approach, lie_down} AND (node is the head [the decision, weight 1] OR chest/forelegs entering the door light: weight ramps over world x 0.80 -> 0.50 m, about 0.6 s; haunch, hind legs, tail stay 0)
rules.preserved: node anchors; the source dog (identity: every piece is the same home-movie dog)
rules.motif: what the dog is made of changes as it comes into the light; the tail never does

rules.id: R8 SPLIT torso at the threshold
rules.output: shaded torso + sunlit chest laid over it (rear edge feathered, alpha = R7 weight)
rules.preserved: S and H anchors of the torso

rules.id: R9 ENTER head -> the door light (look in)
rules.output: head_low_f048 rotated about its neck to a level muzzle (10 deg), the neck reaching in past the jamb at sill height, muzzle into the room
rules.precondition: score act.look > 0.2 (on hearing "come in"); legibility: muzzle inside the door frame at sill height, no more than 20 deg above horizontal (measured on the rendered frame), pointing into the room, not at the bulb
rules.preserved: neck anchor (the neck runs from inside the chest)
rules.motif: the head that came low to trust now reaches level into the house; nothing drawn

rules.precondition: score voice = call (wide arcs travelling to the dog) or soft (small arcs that stay at the mouth)

rules.id: D1 REPLACE door.leaf by the found swing
rules.output: door.leaf at a found angle (Straight Talk closing, played backward)
room = a lit bulb (Light Of Your Life B); light field on the porch
